answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the island check immediately, the mesa audit keeps the resolved set and the grove replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 275 aliases hence pays the reading cost 275 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
